title: Introduce scoped text mods to a new reader
prompt:
The reader has no earlier conversation.
Explain this feature to someone who has never used the product. Describe the install/enable distinction and scopes in plain language.

Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior):
- A text mod is a named, pinned bundle of optional writing instructions.
- Installing stores its version and fingerprint; it does not enable delivery.
- The owner separately enables it for all agents, a repository, watchers, one agent or Overseer.
- All agents excludes both watchers and Overseer.
- Clear prose is available. Less tool noise is planned and inactive.
- The Applied view distinguishes what is desired for a future turn from the last turn’s recorded delivery.
